senses.definition: n.pr.m. (God knows, cf. דְּעוּאֵל, Sab. אלידע Hal 209)
son of David 2 S 5:16 1 Ch 3:8 = בעלידע 1 Ch 14:7 which perhaps read here, cf. DrSm.
father of an adversary of Solomon 1 K 11:23.
chief of Benjamin 2 Ch 17:17.
